longestGapArithmetic.interpretation: SDK decoding/quotes, same-byte independent parity, recording and use checks combined; this is NOT an isolated parity-duration measurement.

simulations.name: trace11-legacy-unreserved-jitter0
assumptions: All services share60 starts/rolling minute,30/rolling10s,>=1s physical starts and one nonpreemptible physical operation.
HTTP durations, parsing costs and start overhead are sampled from retained measurements or explicitly synthetic scenario inputs. Rescheduling them is counterfactual.
Adaptive wake uses only existing gate readiness, protection target and already queued head eligibility, with at most100ms poll interval plus separately declared synthetic timer jitter.
Cache availability is a transport/processing model assuming each fresh response were valid; no old pool state is relabeled fresh or assigned to a new time.
No prices, threshold crossings, fills, profitability, new accepted maximum evaluation gap or production protection guarantee are inferred.
Refused/timed-out selected jobs mark required evidence unusable. Pending financial actions remain explicitly unresolved, never silently erased.

A reconnect job represents one control/upgrade operation. A full seven-account subscription restoration is not modeled by this combined PumpApi path.
